records.en_auxiliary: Um... Uh...

records.jp: ……あの、有理？<CR>千紘をじっと見つめて、どうしたの？
records.en_original: ...Um, Yuri? Why are you staring at Chihiro?
records.en_auxiliary: ...Um, Yuri? Why are you staring at Chihiro?
records.en: ...Um, Yuri? Why are you staring at Chihiro?

records.jp: ああ、君か……。ちょっと彼女を観察していたんだ
records.en_original: Oh, it's you... I was observing her.
records.en_auxiliary: Oh, it's you... I was simply observing her.
records.en: Oh, it's you... I was observing her.

records.jp: うん、見ればわかるよ……。<CR>どうして千紘を見つめてるのかを聞きたかったの
records.en_original: Yeah, I picked up on that... But do you have a reason for doing that?
records.en_auxiliary: Yeah, I picked up on that. But do you have a reason?
records.en: Yeah, I picked up on that... But do you have a reason for doing that?

records.jp: 理由か……
records.en_original: A reason...?
records.en_auxiliary: A reason?
records.en: A reason...?

records.jp: 彼女は悪意という感情を全く持っていないだろう？<CR>そういう人の行動原理を知りたいと思ってね
records.en_original: She has absolutely no feelings of malice, correct? I wanted to learn more about the principals behind such a person.
records.en_auxiliary: She has absolutely no feelings of malice, so I wanted to learn more about the principals behind such a person.
records.en: She has absolutely no feelings of malice, correct? I wanted to learn more about the principals behind such a person.

records.jp: そ、それでじっと見てたんだ……
records.en_original: A-And you thought staring at her would help?
records.en_auxiliary: A-and you thought staring at her would help?
records.en: A-And you thought staring at her would help?

records.jp: わ、わたし……あん……まり<CR>参考……に、ならない……と思う……
records.en_original: I-I... Don't think...I'll make a...very good reference...
records.en_auxiliary: I-I...don't think...I'll make a very good reference.
records.en: I-I... Don't think...I'll make a...very good reference...

records.jp: いや、そんなことはない。<CR>思いのままに過ごしてくれるだけでいいんだ
records.en_original: Quite the contrary. Simply act as you see fit.
records.en_auxiliary: Quite the contrary. Simply act as you see fit.
records.en: Quite the contrary. Simply act as you see fit.

records.jp: 君さえ気にしないなら、<CR>このまま観察を続けさせてもらいたいんだが……
records.en_original: If it's not a bother, I'd like to keep observing you...
records.en_auxiliary: If it's not a bother, I'd like to keep observing you.
records.en: If it's not a bother, I'd like to keep observing you...

records.jp: え？　え、と……
records.en_original: Huh? Um...
records.en_auxiliary: Huh? Um...
records.en: Huh? Um...

records.jp: （千紘、困ってる……まあ、観察させてくれって<CR>いきなり言われても困るよね……）
records.en_original: (Chihiro's having trouble... Like anyone would if someone suddenly said they want to observe you...)
records.en_auxiliary: (Chihiro's having trouble. As I imagine anyone would if someone suddenly said they want to observe you.)
records.en: (Chihiro's having trouble... Like anyone would if someone suddenly said they want to observe you...)

records.jp: 黙ってじっと見つめてるのも変だし、<CR>何か話をしてみるのがいいんじゃない？
records.en_original: It's weird to just silently stare at someone, maybe you should try talking about something.
records.en_auxiliary: It's weird to just silently stare at someone. Maybe you should try talking about something.
records.en: It's weird to just silently stare at someone, maybe you should try talking about something.

records.jp: 話か……なぜ悪意を持たないのか、<CR>その答えに繋がる話題が見つからないな……
records.en_original: Talking... I can't think of a topic that would shine any light on why she has no malice...
records.en_auxiliary: Conversation? I can't think of a topic that would shine any light on why she has no malice.
records.en: Talking... I can't think of a topic that would shine any light on why she has no malice...

records.jp: あはは……すぐには繋がらないと思うよ。<CR>相手のことを知るのって、時間がかかるものだし
records.en_original: Ahaha... It's not something you'd find out immediately. Getting to know someone takes time.
records.en_auxiliary: Ahaha... It's not something you'd find out immediately. Getting to know someone takes time.
records.en: Ahaha... It's not something you'd find out immediately. Getting to know someone takes time.

records.jp: 千紘は？<CR>何か有理に聞いてみたいこととかない？
records.en_original: What about you, Chihiro? Is there anything you want to ask Yuri?
records.en_auxiliary: What about you, Chihiro? Is there anything you want to ask Yuri?
records.en: What about you, Chihiro? Is there anything you want to ask Yuri?

records.jp: わた……し……？<CR>その……有理、さんに……
records.en_original: Me...? Um... Yuri...
records.en_auxiliary: Me? Um, Yuri...
records.en: Me...? Um... Yuri...

records.jp: どん……な……ぬいぐるみ、<CR>好き……か、聞きたい……って……
records.en_original: I...want to know...if there are any...stuffed toys you like...
records.en_auxiliary: I... want to know if there are any... stuffed toys you like.
records.en: I...want to know...if there are any...stuffed toys you like...

records.jp: ぬいぐるみ……？
records.en_original: Stuffed toys...?
records.en_auxiliary: Stuffed toys?
records.en: Stuffed toys...?

records.jp: また変わったことを尋ねるんだな、君は……
records.en_original: That's an unusual question...
records.en_auxiliary: That's an unusual question.
records.en: That's an unusual question...

records.jp: ぬいぐるみなんてものは持ったことがないから<CR>どうとも言えないんだが……なぜそんなことを？
records.en_original: Having never owned a stuffed toway, I can't really answer... Why do you ask?
records.en_auxiliary: Having never owned a stuffed toy, I can't really answer. Why do you ask?
records.en: Having never owned a stuffed toway, I can't really answer... Why do you ask?

records.jp: あの……有理、さん……<CR>ずっと一人で……研究……してる……から……
records.en_original: Um... Because...you're always...researching alone...
records.en_auxiliary: Um... Because... you're always researching alone.
records.en: Um... Because...you're always...researching alone...

records.jp: ぬいぐるみ……が、あれば……<CR>一人じゃ……ないって……
records.en_original: If you...have a stuffed toy...you wouldn't...be alone...
records.en_auxiliary: If you have a stuffed toy, you wouldn't... be alone.
records.en: If you...have a stuffed toy...you wouldn't...be alone...

records.jp: なるほど……有理が寂しくないようにってことだね
records.en_original: I get it... You don't want Yuri to feel lonely.
records.en_auxiliary: I get it. You don't want Yuri to feel lonely.
records.en: I get it... You don't want Yuri to feel lonely.

records.jp: うん……
records.en_original: Yeah...
records.en_auxiliary: Yes.
records.en: Yeah...

records.jp: 寂しさか……。今まで考えたこともなかったな。<CR>今更ぬいぐるみがあったところで変わらないとも思うが……
records.en_original: Lonely... I've never thought of that before. I doubt anything would change if I had a stuffed toy...
records.en_auxiliary: Lonely... I've never thought of that before. I doubt anything would change if I had a stuffed toy.
records.en: Lonely... I've never thought of that before. I doubt anything would change if I had a stuffed toy...

records.jp: だが、善意あってのことだということはわかる。<CR>その気持ちはありがたくいただいておくよ
records.en_original: But I can tell your intentions are good. Allow me to thank you for that.
records.en_auxiliary: But I can tell your intentions are good. Allow me to thank you for that.
records.en: But I can tell your intentions are good. Allow me to thank you for that.

records.en_auxiliary: Of course!

records.jp: ところで、君はぬいぐるみを作る技術を持っているんだったな。<CR>そのデザインを決める時には、何を参考に――
records.en_original: By the way, you make stuffed toys yourself, right? What do you use as reference when deciding on designs...?
records.en_auxiliary: By the way, you make stuffed toys yourself, right? What do you use as reference when deciding on designs?
records.en: By the way, you make stuffed toys yourself, right? What do you use as reference when deciding on designs...?

records.jp: （千紘の気持ち、有理にちゃんと伝わったみたいだね。<CR>良かった……）
records.en_original: (It looks like Chihiro's feelings made an impact on Yuri. That's good...)
records.en_auxiliary: (It looks like Chihiro's feelings made an impact on Yuri. That's good.)
records.en: (It looks like Chihiro's feelings made an impact on Yuri. That's good...)

records.jp: 千紘と同じことをしてみるのは？<CR>そうしたら、何かわかるかも
records.en_original: How about doing the same things as Chihiro? You might learn something about her that way.
records.en_auxiliary: How about doing the same things as Chihiro? You might learn something about her that way.
records.en: How about doing the same things as Chihiro? You might learn something about her that way.

records.jp: なるほど……行動パターンから感情を推測するのか
records.en_original: Interesting... You think I could infer her feelings based on her behavioral patterns?
records.en_auxiliary: Interesting. You think I could infer her feelings based on her behavioral patterns?
records.en: Interesting... You think I could infer her feelings based on her behavioral patterns?

records.jp: そういえば……千紘は、今何してたの？
records.en_original: By the way... What were you doing just now, Chihiro?
records.en_auxiliary: So, uh, what were you doing just now, Chihiro?
records.en: By the way... What were you doing just now, Chihiro?

records.jp: え……？　その……<CR>お花、見て……た……
records.en_original: Huh...? Um... I was...looking at the flowers...
records.en_auxiliary: Huh? Um... I was looking at the flowers.
records.en: Huh...? Um... I was...looking at the flowers...

records.jp: 花を見る……か。<CR>ふむ……リラックス効果はありそうだな
records.en_original: Looking at flowers... Hm... That may have a relaxing effect.
records.en_auxiliary: Taking in the flowers. Hm. That may have a relaxing effect.
records.en: Looking at flowers... Hm... That may have a relaxing effect.

records.jp: そうか、リラックスすると自然と他者を害しようという<CR>悪意も消えるものかもしれない
records.en_original: I see, if one relaxes, it may naturally reduce their desire to inflict harm on others...
records.en_auxiliary: I see. If one relaxes, it may naturally reduce their desire to inflict harm on others.
records.en: I see, if one relaxes, it may naturally reduce their desire to inflict harm on others...

records.jp: いわば花によるセラピー効果を享受しているというわけか。<CR>ああいった精神療法とやらはどれも迷信だと思っていたが……
records.en_original: You could say that the flowers offer a theraputic effect. I assumed that such psychotherapy was mere superstition...
records.en_auxiliary: You could say that the flowers offer a therapeutic effect. I assumed that such psychotherapy was mere superstition.
records.en: You could say that the flowers offer a theraputic effect. I assumed that such psychotherapy was mere superstition...

records.en_original: ...Is that...true...?
records.en_auxiliary: Is that... true?
records.en: ...Is that...true...?

records.jp: わ、わかんない……。<CR>他には？　普段、どんなことしてる？
records.en_original: N-Not a clue... Is there anything else? What else do you usually do?
records.en_auxiliary: N-not a clue. Is there anything else? What else do you usually do?
records.en: N-Not a clue... Is there anything else? What else do you usually do?

records.jp: 普段……ぬい、ぐるみ……<CR>作って……る……
records.en_original: I usually...make stuffed toys...
records.en_auxiliary: I usually... make stuffed toys.
records.en: I usually...make stuffed toys...

records.jp: ぬいぐるみを作る、だと……？<CR>それは、どのような感情を呼び起こすものなんだ？
records.en_original: You make stuffed toys...? What sorts of feelings does that evoke?
records.en_auxiliary: You make stuffed toys? What sorts of feelings does that evoke?
records.en: You make stuffed toys...? What sorts of feelings does that evoke?

records.jp: 感……情……？　え、と……<CR>みんな、喜んで……くれますように……って……
records.en_original: Feelings...? Um... I just...want everyone to...be happy...
records.en_auxiliary: Feelings? Um... I just want everyone to be... happy.
records.en: Feelings...? Um... I just...want everyone to...be happy...

records.jp: なるほど……それは、私にはない発想だな……<CR>一度、わたしもぬいぐるみを作ってその感情を知るべきか
records.en_original: I see... I've never thought that way before. Perhaps I should learn that feeling by making stuffed toys as well.
records.en_auxiliary: I see. I've never thought that way before. Perhaps, I should learn that feeling by making stuffed toys as well.
records.en: I see... I've never thought that way before. Perhaps I should learn that feeling by making stuffed toys as well.

records.jp: ……！　うん……つく、ろう……！
records.en_original: ...! Yeah... Let's...make them together...!
records.en_auxiliary: Yeah! Let's... make them together!
records.en: ...! Yeah... Let's...make them together...!

records.jp: （ぬいぐるみじゃなくてもいいような気はするけど……<CR>二人はやる気みたいだし、これはこれでいいかな？）
records.en_original: (I don't think that's dependent on stuffed toys...but both of them seem enthusiastic, so I guess it turned out fine.)
records.en_auxiliary: (I don't think that's dependent on stuffed toys, but both of them seem enthusiastic, so I guess it turned out fine.)
records.en: (I don't think that's dependent on stuffed toys...but both of them seem enthusiastic, so I guess it turned out fine.)

records.jp: じゃあ――
records.en_original: Maybe...
records.en_auxiliary: Maybe...
